motion.method: per-exposure ePSF position fits (forced.measure_position, ramp policy)

epoch_means_fit.note: diagnostic: epoch means of parallax-corrected positions (epochs with >= 3 points)

motion.note: diagnostic only: no motion criterion for this target

variability.method: later epoch log-flux interpolated in wavelength at the earlier epoch's points (gap <= 1.5 bandwidths); dmag > 0 = fading; errors scaled by sqrt(chi2_red)

field_star_shifts.method: 15-sigma peaks in full-epoch co-adds (target track excluded), 2-D Gaussian centroids, matched within 1 px; median shift of each epoch relative to the last full epoch (grid is north-up)

3-6 px annulus.method: annulus wing index per exposure (wing); dmag relative to the median of the same detector channel over all epochs; phase = (MJD - 57369.5)/246.12 mod 1 (VSX maximum JD 2457370)

8-12 px annulus, robustness variant.method: annulus wing index per exposure (wing_outer); dmag relative to the median of the same detector channel over all epochs; phase = (MJD - 57369.5)/246.12 mod 1 (VSX maximum JD 2457370)
8-12 px annulus, robustness variant.note: chosen after the run showed the 3-6 px ring masked (BLOOM / TRANSIENT / SUR_ERROR) in 82-94% of exposures; reported alongside, the a-priori rows above are the criteria of record
